links.outcome: Emergency physician trust in ambient scribe note accuracy, efficiency, usefulness by note component
links.effect: Trust in accuracy 6/14 (42.9%) vs 6/8 (75%) for in-person scribes; efficiency improved 10/14 (71.4%); helpful for physical exam 3/13 (23.1%), MDM documentation 5/14 (35.7%).
links.quote: However, only 42.9% (6/14; 95% CI 22.3%-69.2%) of respondents trusted the accuracy of ambient scribe-generated notes, compared with 75% (6/8; 95% CI 40.9%-92.9%) who trusted in-person scribes.

screen.reason: Empirical survey and qualitative evaluation of emergency physicians' real-world clinical use of AI-powered ambient documentation technology across 4 EDs.
